title: HyperSU: Corpus-Driven Semantic-Unit Hypergraph for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2606.28351v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent Hypergraph-based retrieval-augmented generation (HyperRAG) methods use hyper edges to connect multiple entities simultaneously, enabling more efficient multi-entity evidence organization than pairwise graph structures. However, existing HyperRAG methods often rely on LLM-generated summaries to construct hyperedges, which can introduce hallucinations while also incurring high indexing costs. In addition, during retrieval, existing methods typically rely on either one-hop neighbor expansion or PageRank diffusion. The former may miss useful multi-hop evidence, while the latter can suffer from uncontrolled propagation over excessive hub nodes, leading to semantic drift and noisy reasoning chains. To address these challenges, we propose HyperSU, a novel hypergraph-based RAG framework featuring semantic-unit hyperedges and clue guided bidirectional retrieval. translated_title: HyperSU：面向检索增强生成的语料驱动语义单元超图
translated_abstract: 摘要：近年来，基于超图的检索增强生成方法利用超边同时连接多个实体，相比成对图结构能够更高效地组织多实体证据。然而，现有 HyperRAG 方法通常依赖大语言模型（LLM）生成的摘要来构建超边，这可能引入幻觉，同时带来高昂的索引成本。此外，在检索阶段，现有方法通常依赖单跳邻居扩展或 PageRank 扩散：前者可能遗漏有用的多跳证据，后者则可能在过度的枢纽节点上发生不受控的传播，导致语义漂移和嘈杂的推理链。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 HyperSU，一种新型的基于超图的 RAG 框架，其特色在于语义单元超边和线索引导的双向检索。在构建过程中，HyperSU 将超边构建形式化为一个实体……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: HyperSU 提出了一种基于超图的检索增强生成框架，通过语料驱动的语义单元超边构建来避免 LLM 生成摘要带来的幻觉与高索引成本，并采用线索引导的双向检索来克服单跳扩展遗漏多跳证据、PageRank 扩散引发语义漂移和噪声推理链的问题。
en_tdlr: HyperSU is a novel hypergraph-based RAG framework that constructs corpus-driven semantic-unit hyperedges to avoid LLM-induced hallucinations and high indexing costs, and employs clue-guided bidirectional retrieval to overcome the limitations of one-hop neighbor expansion and PageRank diffusion, such as missing multi-hop evidence and semantic drift.
